---
title: "Topic: technology adoption"
---

**Technology adoption rate**

- **Definition:** Whether the firm has adopted new technologies during the evaluation period
- **Metric:** Binary indicator (yes/no); number of new technologies adopted; type of technology
- **Data source:** Primary survey (FAT-based questions)

---

**Technology spending**

- **Definition:** Investment in purchasing or licensing hardware and software
- **Metric:** Total technology investment in €; % change from baseline
- **Data source:** Primary survey or administrative (investment tax records)

---

**Technology sophistication**

- **Definition:** The complexity and frontier-proximity of the technologies adopted by the firm
- **Metric:** Categorical scale from basic to advanced technology types; self-reported
- **Data source:** Primary survey

---

**Technology-driven productivity gains**

- **Definition:** Whether technology adoption has led to measurable improvements in efficiency or output
- **Metric:** Self-reported impact on production capacity, unit costs, or quality; combined with administrative productivity data
- **Data source:** Primary survey and administrative

---

**DESI digital technology integration score**

- **Definition:** Level of digital technology integration across the firm's operations, measured against the European Commission's Digital Economy and Society Index (DESI) business digitalization criteria – covering electronic information sharing, cloud computing, big data analytics, social media, IoT, AI, e-invoicing, and e-commerce
- **Metric**: Number of DESI criteria met (out of 12); composite DESI integration sub-score; binary indicator for reaching a defined threshold (e.g. at least 7 of 12 criteria)
- **Data source:** Primary survey (DESI-aligned questions); benchmarkable against Eurostat DESI data at regional and national level
